config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) handbook.cqu.edu.au course pages (/he/courses/view/CODE[/HTn/YEAR], /vet/...) - since 5 Oct the main page kind: the domestic www course pages were rebound to /he/courses/view/<CODE> (plain fetch, no Firecrawl). Intakes from the "International Availability" list (Term N - YYYY then campuses; leading terms marked "Sorry, no international availabilities found" are skipped, a later one ends the reading; the first term read must be 2026 or later). Fee from the "Course Fees" list: "Indicative Year - 2026 ... International Indicative First Year Fee - $35,250" - the international fee for one full-time year, read only inside a 2026-or-later Indicative Year block (an older year is not read; the First Term fee is never read). IELTS from the international English requirement: "IELTS Academic) overall band score of at least 6.0 with a minimum 5.5 in each of the four components". Duration after "Duration". Archived-year handbook URLs (2014-2023) exist but the availability list on them is current. (2) www.cqu.edu.au/courses/xxNN pages still bound (international-only courses with the international header): "Next start term Term N, YYYY ... CRICOS code First-year fee A$X (YYYY Indicative)" - fee is the indicative first-year international fee; intakes = next start term only. term_months from https://www.cqu.edu.au/study/international/enquire-apply-accept/key-dates (Term 1 = 9 Mar 2026 / 8 Mar 2027, Term 2 = 13 Jul 2026 / 12 Jul 2027, Term 3 = 9 Nov 2026 / 8 Nov 2027). Delivery (mode): www pages read "Study mode X"; handbook pages read "online" only when every 2026-or-later term in the International Availability list offers Online alone (the Online terms are the value). A list of campus names with Online is not read, because campus names alone do not say on campus to the delivery reader. 5 Oct: entry_requirement (review only): handbook 'Academic Requirements' / 'Prerequisite Subjects' / 'Assumed Knowledge'. Exit awards are printed by code and name only (no years or credit points), so none are read; no whole-course fee.
